adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` for each `rss.items` entry with no per-item error handling. If `i.content` is `nil` (or any item has malformed data causing an exception), calling `.scrub` (and/or `CGI.unescapeHTML`) will raise and abort the entire job, preventing remaining feed items from being processed.
